hint_html:
If \(f(x)\,=\,x^{n}\) then \(f'(x)\,=\,nx^{n-1}\)

If \(f(x)\,=\,k \cdot u(x)\) then \(f'(x)\,=\,k \cdot u'(x)\)

If \(f(x)\,=\,u(x)+v(x)\) then \(f'(x)\,=\,u'(x)+v'(x)\)

The derivative of a polynomial is determined term by term.
